Package com.neueda.leap.reporting.clients

Record Class ClientDtos.ClientSummary

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.neueda.leap.reporting.clients.ClientDtos.ClientSummary
Record Components:
accountId - account identifier, used in the detail URL
accountNumber - human-readable account number
accountName - account label
clientName - owner's first and last name
email - owner's sign-in email
traderLevel - NOVICE or ADVANCED
status - PENDING, ACTIVE, BLOCKED or CLOSED
tradeCount - number of fills
tradedValue - total value of the fills in USD, to the cent
lastTradeAt - time of the latest fill
Enclosing class:
ClientDtos
public static record ClientDtos.ClientSummary(UUID accountId, String accountNumber, String accountName, String clientName, String email, String traderLevel, String status, long tradeCount, BigDecimal tradedValue, Instant lastTradeAt) extends Record
One trading account in the list, or the summary at the top of its detail page.
